summary.intent: Run the full autonomous post-execute-phase 'ship' pipeline for GSD Phase 68 (cipher-box): verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit review → ship → resolve PR reviews, triaging every finding without stopping to ask.
summary.outcome: Verify/secure/validate stages passed (14/14 must-haves, 41/41 threats closed, 0 Nyquist gaps); the simplify pass and SDK E2E gate uncovered and fixed a real zeroization-order bug in enumerateMoveDescendants plus dead code; SDK E2E went green after fixing two environment issues; CodeRabbit findings across SDK/API/web services were triaged and fixed with regression tests, STATE.md/ROADMAP.md updated, and four todos filed — the transcript ends mid-pipeline before the PR was opened/shipped.

repo: The API's TEE_WORKER_URL defaults to :3001, which is actually the mock-ipns-routing service port locally — the real tee-worker listens on :3002; misconfiguring this silently breaks TEE-related SDK E2E tests without a clear error.
Local tee-worker containers can run stale (pre-current-phase) contract code that must be rebuilt from source before the SDK E2E gate is trustworthy.

Conventional-commit checking on this repo only forbids parens in the description part of the subject — scope parens (e.g. `fix(sdk):`) are valid and don't need rewording, contrary to the runbook's blanket assumption.
apps/web's vitest suite (including ipns.service.test.ts) is not wired into any CI job — a pre-existing broken test there (also broken on main) can go unnoticed indefinitely.

CodeRabbit CLI (`--agent --base main --type committed`) surfaces findings spanning SDK core, API service, and web UX layers in one pass — triage needs to span multiple agents/domains, not just one file area.

code.finding: enumerateMoveDescendants zeroed a parent readKey before the children loop unsealed with it, misclassifying every depth-2+ move descendant as unreadable — fixed and covered by a new red-green-verified regression test.
New regression test added for the move-descendants zeroization-order bug; verified it fails against the unfixed code and passes with the fix (red-green check).
Dead share.service functions orphaned by the rotation cutover removed (zero external references besides comments); also touched again in CodeRabbit pass for related fixes.
Unused exported constant removed as part of dead-code cleanup.

Added a monotonic guard on rootGeneration in updateGrant (PATCH grant) to prevent regressions from stale/out-of-order rotation state; added a corresponding spec case since none existed at the service level.
Multiple CodeRabbit-driven fixes applied, including replacing raw error logs with structured ones.
Edited alongside share.service.ts and ipns.service.ts for a related CodeRabbit finding (overflow guard at the reconcile gate).

workflow: Running long-lived background jobs (security auditor, simplify-review agent, client-chain build) in parallel while the orchestrator handles PR-prep and status checks kept the pipeline moving without idle waiting.
When a test fails mysteriously, swapping in the file's version from main and re-running is an effective way to isolate whether a failure is pre-existing vs. introduced by the phase.
For a claimed bug fix, deliberately reverting the fix and re-running the new test (expecting it to fail) is used to confirm the test actually exercises the bug before trusting it.
Todos for deferred/out-of-scope findings are written to .planning/todos/pending/ with a dated filename (e.g. 2026-07-02-<slug>.md) rather than fixed inline.

friction: SDK E2E gate initially failed due to a stale tee-worker container (running pre-Phase-67 contract) — required diagnosing via BullMQ queue state, republish logs, and container rebuild before the real signal was visible.

Second SDK E2E failure was caused by the API pointing TEE_WORKER_URL at the wrong port (:3001, the mock-ipns-routing service) instead of :3002 — an environment misconfiguration, not a code bug, but took several rounds of log-reading to isolate.

A confusing ipns.service.test.ts vitest failure required an extensive diagnostic chain (diffing against main, tracing import chains, swapping in main's file) before concluding it was pre-existing and not even part of any CI job.
The runbook assumed a conventional-commit reword (git filter-branch) would be needed, but all 86 commits already conformed — wasted a planned step, though caught quickly by a grep check.
